_comment: Subunits Phase 3 cavalry squadron demo (#1290): an 80-man Cavalry regiment staged alone in drill mode. Frontage is derived from cavalry_files (Asclepiodotus 7.4 square/oblong squadron: ceil(sqrt(80)) = 9 columns) rather than the line-infantry aspect ratio (which gave 12 files). The cavalry is structureless (no line-infantry files or persistent per-soldier file identity), reflowing row-major as a cohesive squadron block during maneuvers.
